title: Supreme Judiciary Council approves rules to enhance governance in judicial administration

title: Saudi, Qatari foreign ministers meet to discuss diplomatic efforts for regional de-escalation

title: ‎Maharah CEO: Most strategic contracts renewed

title: ‎KAFD posts 80% office occupancy on high demand
